project.name: backend-interception
project.description: Vertical slice: traffic interception / fault injection rules, and the breakpoint registry that holds a paused call while a human decides what happens to it. Hexagonal internally (domain/application/adapter packages under com.fathy.alfred.backend.interception). A leaf slice - it depends on no other slice and no other slice depends on it. It does NOT evaluate rules: matching and mutation happen entirely inside the mitmproxy addons (proxy/interception.py), against a JSON snapshot this slice publishes, so that no proxied request ever costs a database query or a backend round trip. This slice owns authoring, validation, persistence and the paused-call handoff only.
